subject: Don’t Forget to Transfer Your UEFA Women’s EURO 2025 Tickets or use our resale platform
snippet: Transfer Reminder ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ Webversion Dear Alex Smith, We noticed that you haven't yet transferred your UEFA Women's EURO 2025 mobile tickets or assigned a guest.With match
body:
Webversion(https://ticketing.uefa.com/optiext/optiextension.dll?ID=HbaKsAo9wsmw5F3hryEcYj1CYy-k0gzXEayxChUm3bvy8KzCp7rgqx2gef7l8zPZ3B0CGAKYVMz4ddupTqM)

Dear Alex Smith,

We noticed that you haven’t yet transferred your UEFA Women’s EURO 2025 mobile tickets or assigned a guest.With match day fast approaching, we highly recommend transferring your tickets to your guests in advance to ensure a smooth entry.

If you’re no longer able to attend, you can still offer your tickets for resale via our official resale platform(https://ticketing.uefa.com/optiext/optiextension.dll?ID=YaL40FveDKMJUo8h3iHoavmDsGm_gRsCbKylDXF_QJa3vEkXKmbDmBMH08w1zSM7V4klxyo_YRrUIhLQjW4).

For more information, please visit our FAQ(https://ticketing.uefa.com/optiext/optiextension.dll?ID=_2e3jGVlTMiDEdsh9CEiADlgng8L2v3ghRC-9p-SxL7ziv7Q2kj1vXJ2ghkSX1gWiB62ZFzKXg5GZc-J59Y) section.

Why am I getting this email?

You are receiving this operational email because you have applied for tickets or purchased tickets for this event.

For more information about the use of your personal data, have a look at our Privacy Policy(https://ticketing.uefa.com/optiext/optiextension.dll?ID=KWPFjSAXVtjHMrpSaiGJM7Lz5iQxe_p5t0kGOZW28VjEU5VlK72Cm1i5SJnd72kDJU7041FE3_q-BMHSm8k).
